title: Moving to Dublin
text:
Hi Ania,

Sorry I didn't write last month – I was very busy because I moved to Dublin! I've got a new job in a small IT company in the city centre. I started three weeks ago and I really like it. My colleagues are friendly and my boss is very helpful. I work from Monday to Thursday in the office, and on Fridays I work from home.

I'm living with two other girls in a flat near the river. One of them, Siobhan, is from Galway and she's teaching me some Irish words. The other one, Lena, is from Germany. We often cook together in the evenings.

The weather here isn't great. It rains almost every day, but people say it's normal for Dublin! At the weekends I go walking by the sea or visit museums – many of them are free.

Would you like to visit me in the summer? You can stay in my room, and I can show you the city. Flights from Kraków aren't expensive if you book early.

Write soon!
Marta
